setup.notConfigured: Supabase isn't connected yet, so you can look around but not log in. See README.md, step "Connect the app".
setup.profileMissing: We couldn't find your profile. If you're setting things up, check that the SQL migration was run in Supabase.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: One more step today. Rocco saved your spot.
login.resent: Sent! Check your inbox (and the spam folder, just in case).

signup.title: Let's start
signup.subtitle: Small steps, one at a time. Rocco will walk with you.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
signup.acceptBefore: I have read and accept the
signup.checkText: We've sent a link to {email}. Tap it to confirm your email and you're in.
signup.checkSpam: Nothing there? Have a look in the spam folder too.

links.confirmed: Email confirmed! Welcome aboard. You can log in now.
links.expired: That link has expired or was already used. No problem: you can ask for a new one.

forgot.title: New password
forgot.text: It happens to everyone. Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If there's an account with that email, the link is on its way. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.mismatch: The two passwords are different. Try once more.

welcome.title: Hi, I'm Rocco
welcome.text: I'm a stubborn mountain goat. Sometimes I trip, I patch myself up, and I keep climbing.
welcome.text2: Here we build habits a few steps at a time. No pressure, no guilt. Just the next step.

today.placeholder: Your habits for today will live here very soon.

habits.title: Habits
habits.placeholder: This is where your goals and habits will grow. Coming in the next step.

dreams.title: Dreams
dreams.text: Rocco is still dreaming this section up. Coming soon.

you.title: You
you.exportText: Download a copy of everything you've saved in Goatstep.
you.deleteText: This deletes your account, your habits, your history and all your files. It can't be undone.
you.deleteCheckbox: I understand that everything will be deleted for good.

legal.draft: This page is being written and will be ready before Goatstep is publicly available.

errors.invalidCredentials: Email or password don't match. Try again, gently.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Check your inbox for our link.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts in a short time. Take a breath and try again in a few minutes.
errors.weakPassword: That password is a bit too easy to guess. Use at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
errors.samePassword: That's the same as your old password. Choose a new one.
errors.linkExpired: That link has expired. You can ask for a new one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.exportFailed: We couldn't prepare your file. Please try again in a moment.
errors.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete your account. Nothing was lost: please try again in a moment.
